source.title: Answering Air's Call
source.description:
You strong enough. Understand... yes... you stop corruption.

<The elemental shifts in discomfort.>

Elements in Feralas. Use Essence to find Shrine.

Take fragment. Will help with corruption.
source.objective:
Collect 3 Elemental Essence from the water elementals on The Forgotten Coast across from Sardor Isle in Feralas and combine them with the Fragment of Air to summon help at the corrupted shrine there.

Provided item:
source.completion: Corruption... clarify now. Help needed. Perhaps others... yes... other elements help.
